value.description: JSON input. Runtime validation rejects values deeper than 256 containers before recursive schema parsing.

200.description: Temporary test URL and credentials, no-store

202.description: One authenticated request captured, no workflow execution
One authenticated request captured, no workflow execution

204.description: Exact listed browser origin only, no credentials and no capture

post.description: An unguessable per-run/per-Wait URL accepts one response. Captured Wait configuration may additionally require the existing Pertexo timestamp/raw-body signature or header secret. Body and safe headers become the Wait result. Early responses are retained until the run reaches Wait. Never starts a new run.

requestBody.description: At most 256 KiB raw bytes, additionally subject to retained execution value bounds.

202.description: Callback accepted once; workflow continuation may still be pending

410.description: Callback expired, consumed, canceled or its run closed

413.description: Callback body or retained value exceeds its bounds

503.description: Callback service or rate limiting unavailable

options.description: Allowed exact browser origins only, in Secret URL or Header secret mode. POST only; no wildcard or credentials. Does not accept a callback or start work.

503.description: Callback service or rate limiting unavailable

405.description: Use POST; probes never resume work
Use POST; probes never resume work

204.description: Allowed endpoint origin and explicit request headers. No run starts; no credentials or wildcard origins.

get.description: Starts a run from the query string. Signed endpoints refuse GET with 405, because the signature covers the body.

202.description: Immediate mode, timeout or wait overflow returns {runId,replayed}; an opt-in workflow may also choose status 202 with its configured JSON/text body.

400.description: Invalid request before admission, or the configured workflow response.

401.description: Webhook authentication failed, or the configured workflow response.

405.description: Signed endpoint, which accepts POST only.

409.description: Idempotency conflict, or the configured workflow response.

429.description: Ingress rate limit, or the configured workflow response.

500.description: Failure before a workflow response returns only {code:"webhook.workflow_failed"}; a workflow may instead choose its own status 500 JSON/text body.

503.description: Unavailable before acceptance, or the configured workflow response.

default.description: Opt-in Respond to webhook result (200–599), with JSON or plain text up to 1 MiB, no-store, nosniff and only the safe header allowlist. Work continues after responding.

parameters.name: Content-Type
parameters.description: Required when the request has a body.

parameters.name: X-Pertexo-Signature
parameters.description: Required only in Signed mode. Header secret instead uses Authorization: Bearer or the configured named header. Secret URL authenticates with the address alone.
